DrillChoice.description:
One wrong option, and the authored line that explains it.

``gloss`` is always another real command form's own text, which is what
lets a miss be answered with the truth ("-A stages all changes") rather
than a generic "incorrect".

DrillLevel.description:
Where the drill came from, flat.

Chapter and story identity are carried as plain fields rather than
nested objects: the drill needs a breadcrumb and a way back to the
map, not a second copy of the catalog contract that curriculum owns.

DrillResume.description: An unfinished queue handed back so a return lands mid-drill.

DrillRunState.description:
The client's in-progress queue, bounded before it is stored.

Deliberately structural: the queue drives which questions the learner
resumes into, not what anything pays, so this proves the payload is
small and well-shaped and leaves the card keys to
``sanitize_queue_state`` - which checks them against the level's own
seeded vocabulary.
